name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PArrIs.stable
typeText:
∀ {m m' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {V : List.{0} Nat} {P : Nat} {l : List.{0} (Prod.{0, 0} Nat Nat)},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Agree m m' V →
    (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} V x → LT.lt.{0} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN) →
      LT.lt.{0} P DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN →
        Ne.{1} P DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP →
          P ∉ V → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PArrIs m P l → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.PArrIs m' P l

source.code:
theorem PArrIs.stable {m m' : Mem} {V : List ℕ} {P : ℕ} {l : List (ℕ × ℕ)} (hag : Agree m m' V)
    (hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V → x < IN) (hP : P < IN) (hPH : P ≠ HP) (hPV : P ∉ V) (h : PArrIs m P l) :
    PArrIs m' P l := by
  obtain ⟨⟨h1, h2, h3⟩, h4⟩ := h
  have hhp : IN ≤ m HP := by omega
  have hP' : m' P = m P := hag.var P (by omega) hPH hPV
  refine ⟨⟨by rw [hP']; exact h1, ?_, ?_⟩, by rw [hP', hag.pairsAt hV _ h1 h2 h3]; exact h4⟩
  · rw [hP', hag.heap hV _ h1 (by omega)]; exact le_trans h2 hag.2
  · rw [hP']; exact (RecsIn.of_agree hag hV h1 h2 h3).mono le_rfl hag.2
